design_philosophy: A 'Midnight Trading Floor' aesthetic. Combines the technical authority of an institutional trading terminal with the premium feel of high-end financial education. Restrained use of color, high contrast for legibility, and architectural grid structures.

rules: No generic Sans fonts for headings (Inter is banned for headings). Use Sora for sleek, tech-forward authority.
Overlines/Labels must be Uppercase, Tiny, and Wide spacing (`tracking-[0.2em]`).
Use JetBrains Mono specifically for numeric data, sparkline labels, ticker symbols, and counters to simulate a real trading terminal.
Never exceed `text-6xl` for hero headings. Use clamp or fluid typography.
Use 'Tinted Grey' - rely on the Slate scale rather than neutral greys to add a cool, institutional tone.
Reserve high-saturation accents (Electric Green, Ember Red) exclusively for atmospheric glows, live status dots, chart sparklines, or primary CTAs.
Gradient usage must be heavily restricted to subtle borders (`border-gradient`) or soft background orbs (`bg-emerald-500/10 blur-3xl`). Never use full-screen flat gradients.

surfaces: Crystal Glass: Used for the sticky navbar and floating elements. `bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10`. MUST include the 1px inner stroke.
Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton for the 'Why Us' and 'Course Ecosystem' sections using subtle `border-slate-800` to mimic a technical environment.
Neo-Terminal: For market cards, use a solid dark background with a 1px border and a subtle internal glow.
textures: Subtle noise overlays to kill digital flatness on dark backgrounds.
shadows: Drop shadows are discouraged. Use 1px solid strokes or 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights instead to create depth.

libraries: framer-motion: For scroll reveals, the animated learning roadmap line, and hover elevation.
recharts: MUST USE for the mini sparkline charts on the demo market cards.
react-fast-marquee: For the trust strip or scrolling ticker of stock symbols.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use `py-24` or `py-32` for section gaps. Internal padding for cards must be `p-6` or `p-8`.
grids_and_layouts.course_ecosystem: Use Mode A 'Tetris' Bento grid. Break out of boring uniform squares. Mix tall, wide, and square cards.
grids_and_layouts.hero_terminal: Use Mode B 'High Density Grid' for the simulated demo market cards. Arrange NIFTY, BANK NIFTY, BTC in a tight, scanable layout floating beside or under the hero text.
grids_and_layouts.container: Max-width centered content (`max-w-7xl`), but allow background grids and borders to bleed full width.

rules: Micro-animations on all interactive elements: `hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-emerald-500/50 transition-all duration-300`.
Parallax scroll on the background grid and floating market cards in the hero.
Staggered entrance animations for lists and course cards.
Glowing progress line for the Learning Journey (using Framer Motion `pathLength` animation).

images.description: Abstract neon blue financial line chart. Use as a background layer with low opacity (e.g., opacity-20) mixed with a black radial gradient to add atmosphere.
Business professional at a trading desk with multiple monitors. Ideal for showcasing the 'Practical Learning' environment.
Close up of trader analyzing data. Good for 'Understand/Analyze' steps in the roadmap.
Professional portrait of a mentor in a corporate/trading setting.
Businessman standing in front of stock market graph, conveying authority and experience.

rules: Images must have a heavy dark overlay if text is placed on them (e.g., `bg-slate-950/60`).
Avoid completely replacing the hero image with text; let the financial aesthetics breathe through the UI.

pages_and_sections.Hero: Simulated trading terminal UI. Background has a subtle animated grid and the abstract chart image. Text on left, floating market cards (NIFTY, BTC, etc.) on right with mini Recharts sparklines. The cards must have green/red numbers and 'LIVE DEMO' badges.
pages_and_sections.Course_Ecosystem: 7 unique cards. Give 'Options Trading' and 'Technical Analysis' dominant grid spans. Include a difficulty badge, a market-inspired icon, and a ghost button CTA.
pages_and_sections.Learning_Journey: A vertical or horizontal roadmap. 7 steps connected by an SVG line that 'fills up' with an electric green glow as the user scrolls.
pages_and_sections.SEO_Maps: A clean 2-column layout. Left: Contact info in glass cards. Right: A large placeholder div for the Google Map (`bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center`).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React.js application using Tailwind CSS. Use .js (JSX) extensions, NOT .tsx.

Add fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Sora:wght@300;400;600;700;800&display=swap');
Configure Tailwind config to extend fonts: sans: ['Manrope', 'sans-serif'], heading: ['Sora', 'sans-serif'], mono: ['JetBrains Mono', 'monospace'].
Install required dependencies: `yarn add framer-motion recharts lucide-react react-fast-marquee sonner`
DO NOT use a fully transparent background for the sticky navbar. Use `bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md`.
For the Hero Market Cards, use `recharts` to render a tiny `<LineChart>` with `<Line type="monotone" dataKey="value" stroke="#00E59B" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} />` to mimic real trading widgets.
Ensure the mobile sticky bottom bar is fixed to the bottom with `z-50`, containing 3 distinct action buttons (Book Demo, WhatsApp, Call).
For all actionable elements, implement robust `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="hero-book-demo-btn"`).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (e.g., sharp edges with subtle inner glow, or pill-shaped) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
